apple_dial_already_streaming_here: {host} is already streaming in another window.
apple_dial_not_paired: {host} is not paired yet. Pair with its PIN before streaming.
apple_dial_unreachable_pinned: Couldn't reach {host} — it may be asleep, or its identity changed since you paired. Pair with it again from its host card.
apple_dial_unreachable_unpaired: Couldn't reach {host} — it may be asleep, or not paired yet. Wake it, or pair with it from its host card.
apple_link_confirm_asks_library: A link asks to open {host}'s game library
apple_link_unsaved_browse: {host} isn't saved on this device yet. Add it with the + button first — a library can only be browsed on a saved host.
apple_link_unsaved_connect: {host} isn't saved on this device yet. Add it with the + button — the link points at {address}.
apple_link_unsaved_connect_fp: {host} isn't saved on this device yet. Add it with the + button — the link points at {address}, and carries a fingerprint to verify it against.
apple_pair_keychain_failed: Can't store this device's identity in the Keychain, so the pairing would not survive a relaunch. Unlock the login keychain and try again.
apple_trust_keychain_read_failed: Couldn't read this device's identity from the Keychain. Try again.
apple_trust_no_identity: This device has no identity yet. Connect to a host once to create it.
apple_trust_not_paired_with: This device isn't paired with {host}. Pair with it first.
apple_hosts_arrange_hint: Sort and group the host list
apple_hostcard_default_host_hint: Default host: Start in opens here
apple_hostcard_remove_hint: Deletes the host from this device. The host itself is untouched.
apple_hostcard_presets_hint: A tap on the card connects with the chosen preset; a pinned preset gets its own card.
apple_hostcard_no_presets_body: No presets yet. Make one in Settings, then choose it here.
apple_hostcard_speed_test_pair_first_hin: Pair first to test the network speed.
apple_hostcard_speed_test_pair_first_bod: Pair with {host} to test the network speed.
apple_hostcard_default_hint: Start in opens the default host's library. With one paired host, that host is the default without this switch.
apple_hostcard_pairing_hint: Pairing lets this device browse the library, test the network and send logs.
apple_hostcard_power_hint: Restart and shut down end every stream from this host, and ask first.
apple_hostcard_no_power_body: This host offers this device no power actions.
apple_speedtest_about_body: Measures the stream's own path to {host}: what it carries, loss and jitter at a rate it holds, and what the link does. The recommendation leaves about 30% headroom for encoder bursts.
apple_speedtest_ready_body: Ready to measure the link to {host}.
apple_speedtest_chart_empty_body: The chart fills in as the probe runs.
apple_speedtest_unreachable_body: Couldn't reach {address}. It may be asleep, or streaming to something else.
apple_host_not_saved: That host is no longer saved.
apple_profile_wake_failed: Couldn't get {name}'s desktop ready. Try again in a moment.
apple_lib_bad_art: that game's artwork isn't a web address or an inline image
apple_lib_sections_note: Drag to reorder. A section with nothing to show stays hidden until it has something.
apple_lib_sections_note_tv: Hold a section to move it. A section with nothing to show stays hidden until it has something.
apple_ended_host_error: {host} ended the session with an error
apple_ring_editor_hint_click: Click a button to change it, drag one onto another to swap.
apple_ring_no_touch_tv: Apple TV has no touch screen
apple_ring_no_touch_mac: A Mac has no touch screen
apple_ring_note_no_touch_mac: Not on a Mac — no touch screen
apple_ring_note_keyboard_mac: Not on a Mac — use its own keyboard
apple_ring_note_no_touch_tv: Not on Apple TV — no touch screen
apple_ring_note_mic_tv: Not on Apple TV — no microphone
apple_tv_ring_footer: A short press of {remote} opens quick actions mid-stream, and so does {pad} on a controller.
apple_tv_ring_moving_hint: Select another button to swap the two. {back} puts it down.
apple_tv_ring_pick_hint: Select a button to choose its action; hold it to move or clear it.
apple_tv_ring_slot_hint: Select to change it; hold to move or clear it.
apple_pad_layout_control_a11y_hint: Drag to move; tap to select
apple_controls_gesture_side_edge: Two fingers from a side edge
apple_controls_open_dial_passthrough: Open quick actions in Touch passthrough
apple_fullscreen_on_stream_always_hint: Every stream is fullscreen while Fullscreen is set to Always.
apple_match_window_on_hint: The host follows this window's size — pixel-exact through every resize.
apple_match_window_off_hint: Streams the fixed mode below, scaled to the window.
apple_resolution_notch_hint: Over the notch, macOS blends every frame instead of scanning it out: about 10 ms more display latency.
apple_custom_size_hint: Any size, typed as width × height.
apple_custom_scale_hint: Any scale, typed as a percent from 50 to 400.
apple_bitrate_kbps_gigabit_warning: Above 1 Gbit/s, more than the link carries causes loss and stutter. Run a speed test first.
apple_stats_scale_pct_hint: The overlay's size, on top of the system text size.
apple_prefs_scope_defaults_hint: The settings every preset inherits from.
apple_preset_edit_hint: Hosts and pinned cards follow this preset by id, so renaming keeps them attached.
apple_about_tagline: Low-latency desktop and game streaming with first-class Linux and Windows hosts.
apple_about_source_license: Punktfunk's source is open under MIT or Apache-2.0.
apple_about_swift_packages_body: Punktfunk uses Glur (progressive backdrop blur), © 2023 João Gabriel, under the MIT License.
apple_about_third_party_intro: Punktfunk uses the open-source components below, each under its own license. Video decoding uses the system's own VideoToolbox framework, so nothing is bundled for it — and no Punktfunk client bundles FFmpeg on any platform.
apple_player_pointer_capture_hint: Locks a hardware mouse for mouse-look. Needs the stream fullscreen.
apple_player_overlay_actions_opener_mac: {keys}, the Stream menu or {pad_keys} on a controller opens them mid-stream.
apple_player_overlay_actions_opener: A two-finger twist, {keys} on a keyboard or {pad_keys} on a controller opens them mid-stream.
apple_player_inhibit_shortcuts_release_h: {keys} always stays local — it releases capture.
apple_player_modifier_layout_mac_hint: ⌥ sends Alt, ⌘ sends the Windows key.
apple_player_modifier_layout_windows_hin: The key beside the space bar sends Alt, the next sends Windows — like a PC keyboard.
apple_player_mic_channel_hint: Pick the input your mic is on; Auto sums every channel.
apple_player_audio_format_lossless_hint: Bit-exact PCM, about {rate} Mbit/s on top of the video, or Standard where either side declines it.
apple_player_echo_cancel_mac_hint: Only on the system default devices.
apple_pad_home_button_hint: The system keeps the Home button, so the host never sees it. Add Punktfunk to Home Button Overrides.
apple_player_sc2_capture_mac_hint: Streams a Steam Controller 2 or a 2015 Steam Controller as-is; needs Input Monitoring or Bluetooth access.
apple_player_sc2_capture_ios_hint: Browse and stream with a Steam Controller 2 or a 2015 Steam Controller as-is; needs Bluetooth access.
apple_prefs_overridden_tv: Overrides Default settings — hold to reset
apple_sc2_refused: Couldn't stream the Steam Controller as itself — macOS refused access. Turn Punktfunk on, or off and on, in Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring.
apple_vrr_warning: macOS 26 stutters with variable refresh rate (ProMotion) on. Turn it off in System Settings → Displays, or update macOS.
apple_motion_unreachable_a11y: This controller's motion will not reach the game. Set Controller type to DualSense to enable it.
apple_sc2_passing_through_a11y: Steam Controller connected — passing through to the host as itself.
apple_touch_unsupported_a11y: This host does not accept touch input. Fingers drive the cursor as a trackpad instead.
apple_widget_library_intent_desc: Pick whose game library this widget opens.
apple_widget_library_param_host_desc: Leave empty to follow your most recent host.
apple_widget_library_desc: Jump straight into a host's game library.
apple_widget_library_empty: Open Punktfunk to pick a host.
apple_widget_hosts_empty: Open Punktfunk to add a host.
apple_intent_end_stream_desc: Ends the active Punktfunk streaming session.
apple_intent_connect_desc: Start a Punktfunk streaming session with a host.
apple_intent_param_preset_desc: Which settings preset to use — leave empty for the host's default
apple_intent_open_library_desc: Open a host's game library in Punktfunk, without starting a stream.
apple_intent_wake_desc: Send a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to a host.
apple_intent_error_no_wake: That host has no saved Wake-on-LAN address yet. Connect to it once so Punktfunk can learn it.
apple_usage_local_network: Punktfunk connects directly to your Punktfunk host on the local network to stream video, audio, and input.
apple_usage_microphone: Your microphone is streamed to the connected Punktfunk host, where it appears as a virtual microphone.
apple_usage_face_id: Face ID opens your own account on a host without its password.
apple_usage_bluetooth: Bluetooth lets Punktfunk read your Steam Controller and pass it through to your host.
